title: Evidence preview and home labels
details: Replaces unreliable evidence thumbnails with simple Photo, Video and Audio tiles in both New and Downloaded evidence
Keeps actual captured images in exported evidence PDFs
Locks the four home progress labels to Time, Course, Learn and Test
Prevents legacy AC, GLH, ARP, TOC, KSB and OTJ labels from returning on the home screen
summary: Evia v181 simplifies evidence previews and makes Time, Course, Learn and Test the permanent home progress labels.
changes: Permanent Time Course Learn Test labels
